title: About Dr. Rama Mathur

memberships.name: Liga International Homoeopathic Medical League, Delhi

conferences.name: State Campaign of Homoeopathy for Mother and Child Care

community: Founder and Chairperson, Abhilasha Women's Welfare Society, Jaipur (registered NGO with the Government of Rajasthan).
Honoured by Rajasthan Patrika and Dainik Bhaskar at many medical camps.
Contributed to a blood donation camp organised by Swasthya Kalyan Blood Bank, SMS Hospital and Zanana Hospital, Jaipur.
points: Dr. Rama Mathur is a stalwart in the field of homeopathy. Having done her M.D. in the role of homoeopathy in the management of menopausal syndrome.
She treats different types of acute and chronic diseases.
Sees patients at Raajesh Homeo Home, Banipark, in Hindi and English.
M.D. (Homoeopathy), Rajasthan University (awarded by the Governor of Rajasthan).
NDDY, Gandhi National Academy of Naturopathy.
Empanelled homoeopathic doctor at RIICO for 24 years.
Giving services at MRDC Satellite Hospital, Banipark, Jaipur.
Member, Liga International Homoeopathic Medical League, Delhi.
Has taken part in national and international homoeopathy conferences (list below).
Honoured by Rajasthan Patrika and Dainik Bhaskar at many medical camps.
Keeps detailed clinical notes and records for each patient.
Refers patients to other health practitioners when appropriate.
